messages:
Sofia: Posting the Q4 company OKR draft in the doc. We need a quick product + sales + CS alignment on launch gating for Dedicated v2 and Private EA. Key decision — do we make 99.9% availability an assigned company OKR (committed) or a stretch objective? This affects commit letters for two enterprise deals.

Ana: Can you link the doc? Also what's the timeline to finalize?

okrs-bot: Draft link: https://docs.redwood.ai/q4-okrs-draft (updated 10:32am). Please review and add comments by Friday EOD.

Ryan: FYI sales verbally committed 99.9% to Acme and CompanyX during procurement. We can push GA, but they'd like contract language. Revenue at risk ~ $1.2M if we miss.

Jen: CS note — support ramp is planned around a 99.9% expectation. We're onboarding 2 L2s in Nov. If baseline drops to 99.5% we can manage with current coverage + temporary on-call shifts.

Mike: Engineering: runtime team is mid-kernel refactor this quarter. We can guarantee ~99.5% with current plan. Hitting 99.9% needs KV prefix caching + hot-shard replication work, estimated ~6 weeks.

Ana: Proposal: baseline company OKR = 99.5% availability (committed). Stretch objective = 99.9% with explicit deliverables (KV cache + replication). Sales can include an "intent to deliver" clause and GA window in contracts.

Sofia: Sounds pragmatic. Capture tradeoffs in the OKR doc: acceptance criteria, rollout plan, canary metrics, rollback triggers, and customer credit policy.

Mike: Draft rollout checklist to add to doc:
```
- Canary 10% regional traffic for 2w
- Monitor p99, p95, error-rate, and request-failure-rate
- If errors > 0.1% for 24h -> rollback hot-shard changes
- Enable auto-fallback to smaller model-variant on capacity spikes
```

Jen: Add customer communication templates and the credits table (per-contract credit %) — I'll drop a draft into the doc.

Ryan: If we go with "intent to deliver" we need Legal to sign off on wording. I'll loop Legal after we decide the baseline.

Ana: Decision summary: baseline 99.5% committed; stretch 99.9% with delivery milestones. @Mike add work estimates and timeline, @Jen add CS ramp & comms, @Ryan confirm sales messaging and loop Legal.

Sofia: Final: I'll mark the OKR doc with baseline & stretch and call for sign-off by Fri 5pm PT. :white_check_mark:
